plan.description: Proposal-aligned exploratory extension after inspecting v3 final scores; no confirmatory or pristine-test claim
plan.runtime_note: A100 unavailable on retry; extension uses allocated Colab L4. All new matched controls share the same GPU; historical A100 timing and v3 results stay separate.
plan.selection: Same coefficient_selection labels; macro native task score, first candidate wins ties; no final-driven tuning
plan.hidden_signal: Final hidden layer, attention-mask token mean, difference from frozen base; per-example MSE divided by target delta energy with a fixed floor
plan.router_protocol: Known task head for every expert. Expert-aware router uses base features plus task one-hot, fitted to minimum-GT-NLL expert on fit. Oracle uses final GT and is an analysis-only accuracy ceiling.
